metadata.title: Secure Network Logical Extension SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan governing logical network extensions (e.g., VPNs, VLANs, overlays, tunnels, and peering) as constrained transport mechanisms that must not extend trust beyond Secure Network controls.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security, privacy, and resiliency baseline.

system-characteristics.system-description: Institutional capability governing logical network extensions that virtually extend network reach without extending trust, authority, or security boundaries.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: Logical network extensions inherit governance, assurance, and trust from the Secure Network Platform SSPP.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: Logical extensions terminate at or traverse Secure Network Gateways and do not bypass policy enforcement.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: Resiliency characteristics of logical extensions are inherited from Network Resiliency patterns and controls.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: Where identity is used for extension establishment or session control, assurance is consumed from Secure Identity.

props.name: extension-scope
props.remarks: Logical network extensions provide transport reach only and must not create or imply new trust boundaries.

props.name: trust-extension
props.remarks: Logical extensions must not extend institutional trust, authorization, or segmentation implicitly.

props.name: policy-bypass
props.remarks: Logical extensions must not bypass Secure Network gateways, access control, segmentation, egress discipline, or monitoring.

props.name: lifecycle-control
props.remarks: Logical extensions must be explicitly approved, monitored, and revocable according to institutional policy.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Logical network extensions do not imply trust and must be governed as transport mechanisms within a Zero Trust Architecture.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Overlays and tunnels function as enforcement substrates and must not replace policy-driven access control.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: VPNs and remote connectivity mechanisms are governed as logical extensions subject to explicit controls.

system-implementation.remarks: Secure Network Logical Extensions are implemented as constrained transport constructs that terminate within Secure Network control planes and are continuously monitored.

components.title: Logical Extension Endpoint
components.description: Termination point for logical network extensions where Secure Network controls are enforced.

components.title: Logical Extension Transport
components.description: Underlying transport mechanism (e.g., VPN, tunnel, overlay) carrying network traffic without defining trust.

roles.title: Network Architecture Authority
roles.remarks: Defines approved use, scope, and constraints for logical network extensions.

roles.title: Network Operations
roles.remarks: Operates logical extensions in accordance with Secure Network constraints.

roles.title: Network Security Monitoring
roles.remarks: Monitors logical extension usage and enforces revocation where required.

control-implementation.remarks: Logical extensions inherit security, monitoring, and resiliency controls from Secure Network Platform and Gateway SSPPs. This SSPP documents constraints and assurance only.
